function.name: musical_scale
function.description: Get the musical scale of a specific key in music theory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The musical key for which the scale will be found.

message.content:
C# 大調（C♯ major）的音階（按音程順序）為：

| 音階位置 | 音符 | 調號 |
|----------|------|------|
| 1        | C♯  | ♯   |
| 2        | D♯  | ♯   |
| 3        | E♯  | ♯   |
| 4        | F♯  | ♯   |
| 5        | G♯  | ♯   |
| 6        | A♯  | ♯   |
| 7        | B♯  | ♯   |
| 8        | C♯  | ♯   |

> **備註**  
> - E♯ 在音高上等同於 F，B♯ 等同於 C，但在 C♯ 大調中使用 E♯、B♯ 以保持「七個不同音符」的規則。  
> - 這個音階遵循大調的全半音程模式：全、全、半、全、全、全、半。  

如果你想把它寫成「C♯、D♯、E♯、F♯、G♯、A♯、B♯、C♯」即可。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "C#大調的音階是什麼？" which means "What is the C# major scale?" They want the notes of the C# major scale. We can answer directly: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. But we might also mention enharmonic equivalents: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. Or we could mention that E# is F, B# is C. But the question likely expects the standard major scale pattern: whole step, whole step, half step, whole step, whole step, whole step, half step. So starting at C#, the notes are: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. But we might also mention that E# is enharmonically equivalent to F, B# is C. But the answer: C#, D#, E#, F#, G#, A#, B#, C#. So we can respond accordingly.
